Everyone will give advice: here's mine.

Stop worrying about everyone else for awhile. Just take a few days and be... mindless. Watch cartoons (I recommend Rick and Morty) and funny, light hearted shows. Relax.

The world is a big place. There's lots of shit going on in it that you have no immediate control over. It's okay, no one really has total control over everything. We're all kinda fumbling around in this state of controlled chaos and pretending we know what we're doing. Some people can just take it more than others. It's not a big deal. It's not just you.

Do something physically strenuous at least once a day for awhile. Go round your yard 3 times. Up and down some stairs like 5 times. Don't kill yourself, just say that you are going to do THIS ONE THING today, for sure, set a limit, and do it. This will make you feel like you've not only accomplished something, but that were fully in control of it. It's a subconscious thing - don't think too much about it and don't make it crazy hard.

Slowly re-enter this shitty grown up world we're stuck in, but try to be more like The Dude. You don't need to save the world from itself, you just need to survive your little corner of it.
